_comment: Live golden for tests/live/aeroPoolScan.live.test.ts (ORION_LIVE_RPC=1): the R4 scoping figures for UTC day 2026-11-26, copied (not re-measured) from phase3-r4-scoping/onchain-revenue-data/summary-table.json (gross_usd, alloc_usd; whole dollars) and phase3-r4-scoping/incentives-data/daily.json (allocated_usd; vote_incentives = third_party + foundation_signer_safe_80f7, protocol_subsidy = foundation_subsidy + aero_admin_safe_42255; a chain without a 2026-11-26 entry streamed 0). The scoping read at s and e (Orion reads s-1 and e-1, one block earlier at each end) and priced at day-end spot (Orion: 30-min TWAP on CL edges); both move a chain-day by ~0.01%. Tolerance per chain and figure: rel 0.005 of the expected value, or absUsd 1 (the whole-dollar rounding; a 0 figure).
